faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the JRF (GATE) position at IIT Guwahati is 24th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./M.Tech. degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or allied disciplines. A valid GATE score or CSIR-UGC NET qualification is also mandatory for this position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JRF (GATE) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF (GATE) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates as per the norms of ANRF and the Government of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF (GATE) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF (GATE) position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 44,400.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF (GATE) position will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview round.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The JRF (GATE) position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the institute.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. What are the preferred specializations for the JRF (GATE) role?
faq.answer: The ideal candidate should have a specialization in synthetic chemistry and computational molecular design. A background in Organic Chemistry is also preferred, along with strong practical experience.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: Strong hands-on experience in organic synthesis, multi-step reactions, purification techniques like column chromatography, and characterization using NMR, IR, and Mass Spectrometry is required.
